Auto-switch from work to break at 00:00 and from break to work cannot be observed without waiting 25 or 5 minutes.

# Pixel Pomodoro Timer

A simple offline Pomodoro timer with a pixel-art aesthetic.

## Features

- 25-minute work mode and 5-minute break mode
- Start/Pause and Reset buttons
- Large countdown display
- Keyboard-accessible controls with visible focus states
- Responsive design works from 360px wide
- No external dependencies or network requests

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. Use the mode buttons to switch between work and break, then press Start. Press Pause to pause the timer, or Reset to return to the full duration of the current mode.

## Files

- `index.html` – main page markup
- `styles.css` – pixel-art themed styles
- `script.js` – timer logic

## Accessibility

All buttons are focusable and labeled. The timer display uses `aria-live="polite"` to announce changes.
